requirements.requirement_summary: Proposed first milestone for LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, and Apollo lead-management setup.

deliverables: Set up a LinkedIn list in Sales Navigator
Transfer the LinkedIn list to HubSpot

workflow_questions: Follow-up handling for silent leads and MeetAlfred exports
Transfer of LinkedIn versus Sales Navigator profile links
Visibility of lead email and LinkedIn chat history in HubSpot

execution.status: Attempted under Sales Navigator Advanced; unavailable because access is limited to Advance Plus.
